splitPart.message: The splitPart backend (one-sided world plane) is available; the split dialog and face/sketch-driven selection are not enabled yet.

transform.title: Transform (backend ready, UI in progress)
transform.message: The transform backend (translation, rotation, uniform scale, copy) is available; the dialog and converter mapping are not enabled yet.

deleteBodies.title: Delete parts (in progress)
deleteBodies.message: Deleting bodies is not yet available as a feature operation; use the part tree context menu where supported, or wait for this capability.

deleteFace.title: Delete face (blocked by kernel)
deleteFace.message: The kernel delete-face operation currently returns no geometry, so this capability remains blocked until the kernel supports it.

moveFace.title: Move face (backend ready, UI in progress)
moveFace.message: The moveFace offset backend is available (persistent face references + distance); the face-picking dialog is not enabled yet.

replaceFace.title: Replace face (not exposed)
replaceFace.message: The kernel replace-face operation is not exposed by the editor interface; this capability remains blocked.

wrap.title: Wrap (planned)
wrap.message: Wrap requires curve-to-surface mapping and a solid wrap pipeline; it is registered on the LubanCAD roadmap and is not enabled in this version.

decal.title: Decal (planned)
decal.message: Decals are image display features that produce no solid geometry; an image decal pipeline is not provided in this version and is registered on the roadmap.

modifyFillet.title: Modify fillet (planned)
modifyFillet.message: Modify fillet requires selecting an existing fillet face and re-evaluating it at a new radius; the kernel capability is not integrated yet and is registered on the roadmap.

userFeatures.title: Add custom feature (planned)
userFeatures.message: Custom FeatureScript features are out of scope for this version (examples are registered as excluded-custom-feature) and will be handled by a separate project.

sketchText.title: Sketch text (not supported)
sketchText.message: The Onshape text dialog (font/bold/italic/mirror, 250 chars max) has been captured, but generating text outlines requires a font-outline engine and a new sketch entity type (shared/solver/backend contract). Not implemented in this version; clicking writes nothing.

sketchConic.title: Conic (not supported)
sketchConic.message: Onshape sketch conics require a new conic entity type with solver/backend support; the current sketch contract only has line/circle/arc/spline. Clicking writes nothing.

sketchMidline.title: Midpoint line (planned)
sketchMidline.message: The midpoint-line creation variant is not wired yet; draw a line and use the Midpoint constraint instead. Planned for a later milestone.

sketchEllipse.title: Ellipse (not supported)
sketchEllipse.message: Ellipses require a new ellipse entity type with solver/backend support; the current sketch contract only has line/circle/arc/spline. Clicking writes nothing.

sketchEllipseArc.title: Elliptical arc (not supported)
sketchEllipseArc.message: Elliptical arcs require a new ellipse entity type with solver/backend support; the current sketch contract only has line/circle/arc/spline. Clicking writes nothing.

sketchSplineControlPoints.title: Spline control points (planned)
sketchSplineControlPoints.message: Control-point spline creation is not implemented yet (the existing spline/Bézier tools can be used instead); clicking writes nothing.

sketchIntersection.title: Intersection (planned)
sketchIntersection.message: The intersection tool needs point-on-arc constraints and an intersection pick channel; not implemented yet. Clicking writes nothing.

sketchSlot.title: Slot (planned)
